state: Gomrey PR candidate f0fbf523ac2cabdf81cd91e94c84d31e19def648 on branch feature/rea/w4a-contrast-linter, base feature/rea/nextslide-gamma-wave1 at 6dde5b4a8faea32c64811ee818f053d5fc12dbe3. The change (a) adds servers/fastapi/templates/v2/quality.py, a deterministic WCAG AA theme legibility linter that reuses the existing templates.v2.theme.contrast_ratio rather than adding a second contrast formula; (b) wires it into template_theme_for_presentation as an additive 'legibility' key, leaving the five pre-existing theme keys unchanged; (c) adds 19 pytest assertions in servers/fastapi/tests/unit/test_template_quality.py; (d) adds a donor-derived fixture servers/fastapi/tests/fixtures/donor_nextslide_presets.json with a deterministic regenerator and provenance README; (e) adds the W3 implementation design to the research record. The linter performs no I/O, no network access, no filesystem access and no credential access. It is pure arithmetic over already-resolved theme colour tokens. Gates executed on this exact revision: root npm test 48/48, FastAPI pytest 1144 passed, Next.js node --test 101/101, Next.js eslint 0 errors, Next.js production build success, Electron gates pass, scan-secrets OK, check-fixtures OK, check-platform-support OK, validate-release-config OK, release-manifest OK, presentation-export runtime 1.0.34 verified. The first cut of the linter was corrected before shipping because it applied the 4.5:1 text threshold to the brand fill colour and to decorative borders, which produced false positives on standard design-system pairings such as #2563EB on #F8FAFC; the shipped version applies 4.5:1 only to body text on a card surface, 3:1 to graphical objects, and does not check decorative borders. The pre-existing integration test asserting the exact theme payload was updated to assert the additive key explicitly while keeping the original five-key equality assertion.
